en.sayed-ali-raza: I try to keep myself engaged in piety
so that one the day of great fear it will be peaceful and steady in slippery places.
If I wished I could have taken the way leading towards (worldly pleasures like) pure honey, fine wheat and silk clothes
but it cannot be that my passions lead me and greed take me to choosing good meals
while in the Ḥijāz or in Yamāmah there may be people who have no hope of getting bread or who do not have a full meal.
Shall I lie with a satiated belly while around me there may be hungry bellies and thirsty livers?
Or shall I be as the poet has said:
